text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of an on-street accessible parking space on the west side of Thurston Road.

North York Community Council: 1. Designated an on-street accessible parking space in effect at all times on the west side of Thurston Road located between a point 30 metres south of Manor Road East and a point 5.5 metres further south.
